pages.title: Wet Mortar
pages.text: Seal two Sand with 250 mB water for 1200 ticks to produce four Mortar. Mortar is a building binder, distinct from the Mortar and Pestle workstation.

pages.title: Structural Bricks
pages.text: The shown 2×2 recipe combines three fired Bricks and one Mortar into a Bricks block. The masonry progression setting controls the vanilla recipe replacement. Mortar also binds the Kiln construction recipe.
